title: Loop and export PCM waves
changes: Allow optional audition looping from each wave’s recorded loop start and download one unlooped 8-bit mono WAV at the chosen sample rate.
validation: Synthetic Linux Chrome unit rom-data-viewer-wav-1zs24m0c checked signed sample conversion, RIFF fields, odd and even padding, download payload, loop boundaries and invalid inputs.
Protected EUR unit rom-data-viewer-wav-eur-zm3n1sb2 compared all 277 waves with the source and checked every WAV sample conversion and an actual loop point in Chrome.
limitations: The sample rate is a user-selected audition setting; the WAV does not carry loop metadata, and the optional loop does not assert the game uses it. Physical audio output was not checked.
